articles.summary: TOYO Co., Ltd (Nasdaq: TOYO; OTC: TOYWF) ("TOYO" or the "Company"), a solar manufacturing company, today announced that it will exhibit at RE+ 2026, taking place November 16–19, 2026, at the Las Vegas Convention Center in Las Vegas, Nevada. The Company will also participate in the 13th Annual ROTH Solar Storage Symposium, held during RE+ on November 17, 2026. TOYO will exhibit at Booth #N3136 from November 17 to 19. Visitors can meet the TOYO team to learn about the Company's high-efficiency solar products and its U.S. manufacturing operations in Humble, Texas. TOYO management will participate in one-on-one meetings with institutional investors during the ROTH symposium. Attendance at the symposium is by invitation only for ROTH clients. Interested investors should contact their ROTH sales representative to schedule a meeting. Other investors and members of the media who wish to meet with TOYO management during RE+ may contact TOYO Investor Relations at IR@toyo-solar.com . About
articles.title: TOYO to Exhibit at RE+ 2026 and Participate in ROTH Solar & Storage Symposium
